visual_description: A cloaked figure, hunched over a smaller one. Blue and red swirl through their folds. Sorrow flows between.
emotional_response: Protection. Apology. A goodbye too soft to finish.
rational_analysis: Image of loss or transmission. Grief as legacy.
existential_reflection: Maybe Mizontresh didn’t kill. Maybe it *carried.* All that we refused to hold. Until it became too heavy to stand.
